citations.quote: Transaction-based attribution is the most complete form of attribution identifying all sources of return and reconciling exactly to the published return.
Cash Flows The framework by itself does not address cash flows between segments.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Transaction-based attribution reads value-add directly from trade-level data, reconciling exactly to the published return and capturing intraperiod timing, bid/offer, and transaction costs that holdings-based attribution leaves as a residual.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Transaction-Based Attribution and the Trading-Cost Bridge
